gender systems are not autonomous but are inextricably bound to class relations and vice-versa, and that this relationship is not a stable and static one, but is subject to historical variation and change.

the gender order is autonomous in that its internal dynamics of reproduction and change are not reducible to class relations.
the gender order is not autonomous and that the gender order and the social formation are mutually constitutive, but that the gender order has its own logic and dynamics.
gender systems are not simply autonomous, but neither are they simply determined by the economic system.
